description: Extract LinkedIn profile data as structured JSON (name, headline, location, profilePic, connections, about, sections[{heading, items[{title, subtitle, meta}]}], recentActivity). Navigate to linkedin.com/in/USERNAME/ first. Sections include Experience, Education, Skills, etc. Use linkedin.com/in/me/ for the logged-in user's own profile.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

name: browser_extract_li_profile
